html:
Greetings, Agents. 

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

The Spider-Men are gathering across the multiverse
to carry out the responsibilities and duties of a Super Hero!
We have prepared the June Update
in celebration of the Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse! 

 

The Web Warriors have been upgraded with Tier-4 for Spider-Man (Miles Morales), 
Tier-3 for Spider-Man 2099, and a new Uniform for Spider-Woman.

 

And a new Super Villain that will challenge the Spiders has been added!
Spot has been added and will become a powerful foe
by receiving Potential Transcendence together with Scorpion.

 

And another threat has emerged from a different timeline!
Watch out for the attack of the World Boss: Legend <Kang the Conquer>!  

 

We have prepared various improvements for Agents who are preparing for the new battle 
such as Game Tips for new Agents, improvements on the X of Swords & Otherworld Battle,
and changes on the highest score of Alliance Battle, so please stay tuned! 

 

Please check the details below.

 


▣ One New Hero

 

Spot <Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse> has arrived across the Spotted Dimension! 
Be aware of his attacks from everywhere using the black spots on his body.
* The hero skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.
* We will make further announcements on the event schedule 
and content of the Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse inspired update.

 

 


▣ Three New Uniforms

 

New Uniforms have been added to the next-generation Spider-Man, 
Spider-Man from the future, and the mother Spider-Man.
Check out the abilities of Spider-Man (Miles Morales) <Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse>,  
Spider-Man 2099 <Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse>,  
and Spider-Woman <Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse>.  
* New Uniform Skills are based on the following skill Level stats. (Tier-4 heroes: Lv. 10, Others: Lv. 6)      
* The three new uniforms will be on sale for 40% off during the <June Update Celebration Event>, 
and can be checked and purchased in the Marvel Universe and the Uniform Room after the event.

 

 

 

 


▣ Spider-Man (Miles Morales) Tier-4

 

Tier-4 advancement has been added to Spider-Man (Miles Morales).
Check out how he has become stronger to take on the huge responsibility of saving everyone.
* The skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 


▣ Spider-Man 2099 Tier-3

 

Tier-3 Advancement has been added to Spider-Man 2099.
Check out how he has been enhanced with future technology!

 

 

 


▣ Spot, Scorpion Potential Awakening & Transcendence

 

Potential Awakening & Transcendence will be added
to Spot and Scorpion through the June Update!
* The skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

 

 

▣ World Boss: Legend <Kang the Conqueror> Release & Improvements  

 

Kang the Conqueror, a powerful Super Villain who threatens all Timelines 
with advanced technology and intelligence, has arrived at the World Boss: Legend difficulty.

 

1. Agents can challenge Kang the Conqueror from Difficulty 1 after clearing the unlock challenges.
- Challenges such as including a specific hero have to be cleared to unlock every 10 stages.

 

 


2. The maximum conquer level of Kang the Conqueror is 200.
Odin's Blessing Chest, Dimension Chest: C.T.P., and Tier-3 Advance materials can be acquired 
and conquer effects will be enhanced when the conquer level rises.
- Conquer effects for Kang the Conqueror have been added in the conquer effects of Dark Phoenix.

 

 

3. Acquire various items by clearing Kang the Conqueror.
​- The Mighty C.T.P. of Greed can be acquired from Kang the Conqueror.      
- Cosmic Cube Fragments will be acquired at a 100% rate in the World Boss: Legend difficulty.

 

 

4. Today’s World Boss has been improved 
so that multiple bosses can be selected when using the Auto-Reset feature.

 

 

5. The total battle time can now be checked at the World Boss clear result screen.

 

6. The remaining battle time will now be displayed in the last phase of World Boss: Legend <Knull>.

 

7.  The damage calculation method and hit range 

of some range attack skills of World Boss: Legend <Knull> have been adjusted.

 

8. The activation timing of some patterns of World Boss: Legend <Dark Phoenix> has been adjusted.

 


▣ Otherworld Battle Improvements

 

Analyze and manage various factors that change throughout the season 
with debuffed heroes that change every week to win the battle! 

 

1. Debuff effects will be applied to debuffed heroes in ranks Vibranium or above.
- Three heroes will be debuffed every week, up to a maximum of six heroes.
- Debuffed heroes will be changed at 14:59 (UTC+0), 7:59 (PDT) every Sunday.
- Debuffed heroes will be selected from Season 2, and will be applied from the second week.
* No hero will be debuffed in the first week.

 

 

2. The remaining purchase time of Battlefield Buff items can be checked at the Battlefield Shop list.

 

 

3. The battle progress time can now be checked at the win record.

 

4. Your Agent information will now be emphasized with a frame 
when ranked in The Top 100 / Previous Season Rank.

 

5. The calculation time after the end of the season has been changed from five minutes to two hours.

 

6. Special Icons will be added as a seasonal reward for leagues Gold and above.

 

7. A tutorial for Otherworld Battle has been added.

 

8. The remaining time until the battlefield effects are changed will be displayed.
- Battlefield effects may be changed during the season from Season 2.

 


▣ X of Swords Improvements

 

Various convenient features have been added
so that Agents can enhance Swords or manage the Inventory space more easily.

 

1. The Auto Select feature for dismantling Swords has been added.

 

 

2. The Bulk Enchant feature that enchants multiple Swords at once has been added.
- Tap the Enchant Rune icon to select the material. Only one type of Rune can be selected.
- Agents can select only one enchant level,
and the enchant count can be selected to a maximum of 50 times.

 

 

3. The Auto-Dismantle feature that will dismantle Swords with a set number of elements
when using the Bulk Enchant feature has been added.

 

 

4. +6 level Swords of the Unknown and Awakened Swords 

can be converted into the Sword of Growth at the Inventory using Gold.
- The Sword of Growth can be piled up in the Inventory.
- The Sword of Growth will not have any elements or options and cannot be equipped.
- The Sword of Growth can be used as a material when upgrading the Agent Level.

 

 

5. The Sword Colors Assist Mode has been added to the Menu - Settings - Option.
- This feature can also be activated at the upper right side of the Sword Enchant screen.

 

 

6. The enchant chat log will now only be displayed when the element level is +5 or above.

 

7. The UI of Element Mastery Tips has been improved.

 


▣ New Artifacts

 

Exclusive Passive Skill Artifacts for Spider-Man 2099, Spider-Woman, 
Spot, and Scorpion will be added after the June Update.
* The skill effects are based on Lv.4 stats.

 

 


▣ New Future Pass Season & Special Icons

 

A new season of Future Pass will begin after the update.

[Future Pass Rewards]

- Please note that the Future Pass effects will apply upon purchase and cannot be refunded.
- Legendary / Mythic Future Pass that has been unlocked 
will only be applied during the season the Pass was purchased,
and the Pass rewards will only be available during the same season. 
Please don’t forget to check the remaining event time.
- The Mythic Pass can be purchased after purchasing the Legendary Pass.
- Legendary and Mythic Future Passes will not be available for purchase 
when the season is about to end. Please check the sale schedule in the game.
          
​New Special Icons that will represent you have been added.
Collect two new Icons as Future Pass Rewards, one as Otherworld Battle rewards, 
and two more from the upcoming Event!

 

[June Update New Special Icon]

 


 


 


     

 

 

▣ Other Improvements and Changes

 

1. A feature to view Tips has been added to the My Team screen and specific game modes.
- Check out the Tips by tapping the Jocasta icon!
- The Game Tips can be set On / Off at Menu - Settings.

 

 


2. The Show S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy Guide Mission option 

has been added to the Menu - Settings - Option.

 

 

3. A feature to exclude the top 10 heroes as a supporter
when Auto Repeating Multiverse Invasion has been added. 

 

 

4. The Invite All feature has been added in Giant Boss Raid. 

 

 

5. The hero information can now be checked easily from the Team and Selector screen. 
- The Character Overview button where details of the hero can be checked has been added.
- A feature to check the target that a skill applies to has been added.

 

 

 

6. The Support, Dealer, and Leader categories have been added to the All filter at My Team.

 

7. The highest score that can be achieved at Alliance Battle: Extreme and Legend have been changed. 
[Extreme] 12,000,000 → 18,000,000 points.
[Legend] 10,000,000 → 15,000,000 points.

 

8. A guide button where information on each game mode can be found
has been added to the title of the game mode that is displayed on the top.

 

9. A pop-up screen where the acquisition method of items can be checked has been added.
- Artifact / Custom Gear: Can be checked at the Team screen when not equipping an item.
- Comic Card Crafting Cube & C.T.P. Reforging Core: 
Tap the icon of the item on top of the Craft & Reforge screen.
- Comic Card: Tap the Get Comic Cards button on the equipped card screen.

 

10. The combo practice has been added for 
Rocket Raccoon <Marvel Studios’ Guardians of the Galaxy 3> in the skill preview. 

 


▣ Game Error Fixes

 

1. Agents will no longer be damaged after some attack patterns of Giant Boss Raid: Dormammu end.

 

2. Heroes will no longer use only basic attacks 
instead of skills when using the Auto-Progress feature in certain conditions.

 

3. The issue of some X of Swords effects not being applied to some heroes has been fixed.

 

4. The issue of a pop-up showing that the maximum number of items has been reached being displayed when acquiring an unowned hero from a Selector in specific situations has been fixed.


5. The Battlefield effect <Decreases defenses by 35%: Universal> being displayed as 40% 
when tapping the battle icon after entering Otherworld Battle has been fixed.

 

We will return with various content improvements, so please stay tuned.

 

Thank you.
